original_stage.architecture: IntegratedModelV42 for T1-7; IntegratedModelV44Fix for T8
original_stage.checks: Saved step, full_model, checkpoint SHA and training data SHA must agree. For the historical 28000 branch, original parent fork checks also apply. Interrupted Tier logs require inspection before rerun.

known_source_baseline.verification: value pinned by source; checkpoint bytes not read in this registry task

original_stage.future_checkpoints: Stage supports explicit --run --step --checkpoint-sha; no training launcher is invoked. Python/extended original 30500 CLI is step/branch-specific; use original scorer APIs under independently verified checkpoint bindings.

limitations: No model checkpoint or GPU generation was executed while preparing this registry.
Historical gate/sentinel full inputs are absent; source code alone does not constitute a complete suite.
All training/dev source overlap by semantic paraphrase cannot be ruled out by exact prompt hashes alone.
